as_told.title: Luis Walter Alvarez behind the original pyramid muon scanning

plain: The physicist Luis Alvarez, a senior figure in the Manhattan Project, is said to have scanned one of the Giza pyramids for hidden chambers using muons, particles from space that pass through rock. Luke Caverns, a researcher of ancient Egypt, says Alvarez took a team there in the 1960s and scanned the pyramid of Khafre. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source, on two other episodes: once saying Alvarez, "depicted in the movie Oppenheimer," "x-rayed the pyramids in the 50s," and once placing it in the 1970s, in neither case naming the pyramid. The tellers bring it up to show that serious scientists have looked for what lies hidden inside the pyramids.
